assets.label: Left shoulder flames
assets.prompt: Use case: compositing. Create ONLY ONE isolated decorative overlay asset for an existing storybook watercolor character portrait. Original character in reference is a positioning/style reference only and MUST NOT appear in output. Preserve wide chunky visibly separate angular gouache/watercolor strokes, soft pigment variations, opaque paint and grain within marks, a few clear value groups. Tight readable group on genuinely transparent alpha with transparent padding. No character anatomy, fur, paws, face, background, paper rectangle, frame, labels or text. No photorealism, glossy 3D, delicate microdetail or complex pattern. This will be anchored programmatically over the unchanged original portrait. A small outward curling plume of THREE soft flame tongues for the viewer-left shoulder of Hero. Cream-gold inner paint, amber/orange middle, sparse muted coral tips, one tiny ember at most. Gentle S-shaped flame group, compact and asymmetrical, lean left with broad pointed brush ends. No animal fur or silhouette. Restrained elemental accent, not a fireball.
